candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 24 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E no dey cough or get wahala to breathe. E no get fever. E no get ear problem. E no dey bleed for stool. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. For diarrhoea, e dey drink poorly. E no dey restless or irritable. Wen I pinch the skin, e return normal. E get sunken eyes.
